Write a company culture document I can share with candidates during the hiring process for my company [name]. We're [describe: size, industry, remote/in-person, stage].
Include: (1) Our mission — [state it, or ask AI to help you draft one based on: what we do, who we serve, why it matters], (2) Our values — suggest 4-5 values based on [describe what you actually care about, e.g., "honesty over diplomacy, speed over perfection, ownership not task-following"] with a one-sentence description of what each looks like in practice, (3) How we work — communication norms, meeting culture, async vs. sync, tools we use, (4) What we expect — the non-negotiables, (5) What we offer in return — growth, autonomy, flexibility, compensation philosophy, (6) Who thrives here and who doesn't — be honest. This should self-select the right people in and the wrong people out.

I've been approached about (or I'm considering) a partnership with [company/person name]. Here's the opportunity:
- What they're proposing: [describe]
- What's in it for me: [perceived benefits]
- What's in it for them: [their benefits]
- What they're asking me to commit: [time, money, exclusivity, etc.]
- My hesitations: [what's giving me pause]
Evaluate this partnership by: (1) Alignment check — do our audiences, values, and goals actually align? (2) Upside analysis — best case scenario and is it meaningful? (3) Downside analysis — worst case scenario and can I live with it? (4) Hidden costs — what's this going to cost me beyond the obvious? (time, reputation, opportunity cost), (5) Deal structure — if I should do it, what terms should I negotiate? (6) Red flags to watch for, (7) Go/no-go recommendation with clear reasoning.
